cohort: The cohort consisted of 3,873 women with Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) who had singleton pregnancies following frozen embryo transfer (FET) between October 2017 and December 2021.
finding: mNC-FET was associated with more favorable obstetric outcomes, including lower rates of miscarriage, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and higher term birth rates, compared to PC-FET in women with PCOS.
mod_finding: mNC-FET was associated with significantly lower rates of cesarean section and emergency cesarean section compared to PC-FET.
